question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH constructor_totals AS (
    SELECT ra.year, cs.constructor_id, SUM(cs.points) as constructor_total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races ra ON cs.race_id = ra.race_id
    GROUP BY ra.year, cs.constructor_id
),
best_driver_points AS (
    SELECT ra.year, cs.constructor_id, MAX(r.points) as best_driver_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN constructor_standings cs ON r.race_id = cs.race_id
    JOIN races ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id
    GROUP BY ra.year, cs.constructor_id
),
combined_scores AS (
    SELECT ct.year, ct.constructor_id, ct.constructor_total_points, bd.best_driver_points, ct.constructor_total_points + bd.best_driver_points as combined_points
    FROM constructor_totals ct
    JOIN best_driver_points bd ON ct.year = bd.year AND ct.constructor_id = bd.constructor_id
)
SELECT c.name, cs.year, ROUND(cs.combined_points, 1) as combined_points
FROM combined_scores cs
JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cs.combined_points DESC) <= 3
ORDER BY cs.combined_points DESC
